aiTitle: Sunday Reset: Ada's Monitor and Meal Prep

message.content: Good morning. It’s quiet here. Grace left for the office about an hour ago, and Ada is finally asleep. I need to get some things done while I have the house to myself. First, I need to send a quick message to my colleague, Sarah. Can you draft a text saying I’m still out on parental leave but will check emails next week? Keep it professional but warm.

content.text:
Here is a draft for Sarah:

"Hi Sarah, just a quick note to let you know I’m still on parental leave with Ada. I’ll be offline for the rest of this week to focus on her, but I plan to check emails next Monday. If anything urgent comes up, please flag it for Grace. Hope you’re having a good week!"

Shall I send this to her?

message.content: Yes, please send that. Thanks. Now, I need to tackle the baby monitor situation. I know I was looking at Owlet last week, but I’ve changed my mind. We’re going back to Nanit. I decided on that on Friday 20 March, and I’ve been thinking it over since. Can you update my shopping list to remove the Owlet Pro and add the Nanit Plus camera instead?

content.text: I’ve updated your shopping list. The Owlet Pro has been removed, and the Nanit Plus camera is now added. I’ll also make sure to include the necessary mounting bracket since the Nanit kit doesn't always come with one by default. Is there anything else regarding the nursery setup?

message.content: No, that’s it for the nursery. Now, I’m thinking about dinner. I want to cook something simple but nutritious. Can you suggest a recipe for roasted chicken thighs with root vegetables? I need to make sure I have the ingredients in the cart. Also, remind me to buy more spinach for my salads this week.

content.text: I’ve added a recipe for Herb-Roasted Chicken Thighs with Root Vegetables to your meal plan for tonight. I’ve also added spinach to your grocery cart. The chicken thighs are currently out of stock at the local store, but I can order them from the online delivery service for pickup tomorrow morning. Would you like me to do that?

message.content: Yes, please order the chicken for tomorrow. It’s Sunday, so I have time to prep. Speaking of prep, I need to sort out some paperwork. I have that tax document from my firm that needs signing. Can you pull up the PDF from my secure folder and remind me of the deadline?

content.text: I’ve located the document: 'Okoye Family Trust - Q1 2026 Tax Summary.' The deadline for signing is April 15, 2026. Since it’s currently March 22, you have plenty of time. Would you like me to set a reminder for next Friday to ensure it gets signed before you return to the office?

message.content: That would be helpful, thanks. I’m feeling a bit overwhelmed with all the logistics. How am I doing on sleep lately? I know I’ve been trying to establish a routine. My goal is to get 8 hours straight.

content.text: Based on your sleep tracker data from the last two weeks, you are averaging 6.5 hours of continuous sleep. However, on the nights you used the white noise app we set up, you managed to hit your goal of 8 hours straight. You’re doing well, Daniel. Consistency is key right now.

message.content: Thanks for the encouragement. I think I’ll take a nap while Ada sleeps. Can you mute all notifications except for emergency alerts? And please set an alarm for 2 PM so I can wake up and start dinner prep.

content.text: Notifications are now muted except for emergency alerts. Your alarm is set for 2:00 PM. Enjoy your rest, Daniel.
